name: Poison Cloud
description: Billowing green toxic gas cloud expanding outward
preview_html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<style>*{margin:0;padding:0}body{background:#020a02;overflow:hidden}canvas{display:block}</style>
</head><body>
<script src="../../vendor/three.min.js"></script>
<script>
(function(){
var W=innerWidth,H=innerHeight;
var renderer=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({antialias:true});
renderer.setSize(W,H);renderer.setClearColor(0x020a02);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);
var scene=new THREE.Scene();
var camera=new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(60,W/H,0.1,100);
camera.position.set(0,1,5);camera.lookAt(0,1,0);
function makeCloud(n,sz,col,op){var pos=new Float32Array(n*3),vel=new Float32Array(n*3),life=new Float32Array(n);function reset(i){pos[i*3]=(Math.random()-0.5)*0.5;pos[i*3+1]=Math.random()*0.3;pos[i*3+2]=(Math.random()-0.5)*0.5;var a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2,sp=0.003+Math.random()*0.01;vel[i*3]=Math.cos(a)*sp;vel[i*3+1]=0.006+Math.random()*0.012;vel[i*3+2]=Math.sin(a)*sp;life[i]=0.4+Math.random()*0.6;}
for(var i=0;i<n;i++){reset(i);life[i]=Math.random();}
var geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();geo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.BufferAttribute(pos,3));
scene.add(new THREE.Points(geo,new THREE.PointsMaterial({size:sz,color:col,transparent:true,opacity:op})));
return{pos,vel,life,geo,reset,n};}
var clouds=[makeCloud(600,0.10,0x44ff55,0.38),makeCloud(200,0.16,0x22cc33,0.22),makeCloud(150,0.06,0x88ff66,0.55)];
window.addEventListener('resize',function(){W=innerWidth;H=innerHeight;renderer.setSize(W,H);camera.aspect=W/H;camera.updateProjectionMatrix();});
var t=0;
function animate(){requestAnimationFrame(animate);t+=0.012;
  clouds.forEach(function(c){for(var i=0;i<c.n;i++){c.life[i]-=0.003;c.pos[i*3]+=c.vel[i*3]+Math.sin(t+i*0.07)*0.0007;c.pos[i*3+1]+=c.vel[i*3+1];c.pos[i*3+2]+=c.vel[i*3+2]+Math.cos(t+i*0.07)*0.0007;if(c.life[i]<=0)c.reset(i);}c.geo.attributes.position.needsUpdate=true;});
  renderer.render(scene,camera);}
animate();})();
</script></body></html>
